```
public function total(invoice: Invoice) returns Decimal
  purpose: Subtotal after the percentage discount, rounded to cents.
  see also: subtotal

  let kept be 100.00 - invoice.discount_percent
  let discounted be subtotal(invoice) * kept / 100.00
  return discounted.rounded(2)
end
```

```
public function total(invoice: Invoice) returns Decimal
  purpose: Subtotal after the percentage discount, rounded to cents.
  see also: subtotal

  let before be subtotal(invoice)
  let hundred: Decimal be 100
  let kept be hundred - invoice.discount_percent
  return (before * kept / hundred).rounded(2)
end
```

```renyi
public function total(invoice: Invoice) returns Decimal
  purpose: Subtotal after the percentage discount, rounded to cents.

end
```
